correctness.rationale: For all integer bases b>=2, the proof gives a uniform ones-spacing upper bound eliminating all k>=2 at b>=4 and k>=3 at b=3. The remaining b=3 and b=2 cases are handled with exact residue/valuation conditions; b=2 long alternating runs are excluded because one of four consecutive odd positions has even bit. Floor sums count parity-of-valuation events at every finite cutoff, and convergent geometric series give frequencies. Bundled standalone verifier passed all declared finite tests; infinite result rests on proof.

value.rationale: The natural antisquare factor invariant is completely classified at all lengths and every integer base, including a sharp base-dependent jump in language size. Every individual factor also gains a precise arithmetic occurrence set, exact finite-prefix count and rational limiting density, extending the qualitative avoidance literature with nontrivial quantitative information. No generic theory or downstream theorem is claimed.
